scope.paper_mainline: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol

frozen_computations.task_unit: sha256(task\0raw_task_id); emitted only in mode-0600 private witness
train_coverage: induced canonical sibling pairs by task
frozen_computations.coverage_deltas: yield_guarded_breadth minus exact_b_uniform_edge at the same endpoint budget
frozen_computations.task_sign: sign of integer net-correct contribution; zero is retained
frozen_computations.leave_one_task_out: pooled accuracy delta after removing each task, with min/median/max and negative/zero/positive counts
frozen_computations.positive_gain_concentration: largest and two-largest positive integer contributions divided by total positive contribution; HHI over positive contributions
frozen_computations.distribution_distance: L1 distance between each arm induced-pair task share and outer-train available-pair task share
frozen_computations.correlation: nine Spearman coefficients: each of selected-endpoint, selected-run and induced-pair coverage deltas versus each of accuracy, log-loss and Brier task deltas; Pearson correlation of deterministic average ranks; all evaluation tasks included and missing train counts fixed to zero
frozen_computations.floating_point: Python binary64; probabilities clipped to [1e-15,1-1e-15] only for log loss

outputs.public: aggregate only; no raw or hashed task/run/pair identity and no per-pair probability
outputs.private: one row per task and budget with task SHA-256, train coverage and evaluation deltas; mode 0600
outputs.independent_verifier: reconstructs all private rows and public aggregates from bound inputs without importing producer; zero model refits

interpretation.permitted_use: choose whether a separately frozen task-quota plus yield-floor acquisition rule is scientifically motivated
interpretation.forbidden_use: claim efficacy, remove/reweight a task, retune the existing smoke, or treat historical fold0 as confirmation
